purpose: To inform the Registrar about the details of share warrants issued prior to the commencement of the Companies Act, 2013 and not converted into shares.
who: Every public company which issued share warrants prior to commencement of the Companies Act, 2013 and not converted into shares
when: Within a period of three months of the commencement of the Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Second Amendment Rules, 2023
steps: Identify details of share warrants issued prior to the commencement of the Companies Act, 2013 that are not converted into shares.
File Form PAS-7 with the Registrar.
checklist: Details of share warrants issued prior to the commencement of the Companies Act, 2013
watch: Form PAS-7 must be filed within a period of three months of the commencement of the Companies (Prospectus and Allotment of Securities) Second Amendment Rules, 2023.
